entities.summary: Victor Dewayne Rudd is an American professional basketball player for Al-Arabi of the Qatari Basketball League. He played college basketball at Arizona State University, and at the University of South Florida. At a height of 6 ft 9 in (2.06 m), he plays at the power forward position.
